title: Luminous Cluster in Storm
description: A mysterious glowing mass of multicolored circular orbs and fragments hovers in the center of a dark, turbulent atmosphere. Golden wires and mechanical elements are intertwined within the cluster, which emits warm light from its core against a backdrop of swirling stormy clouds in deep greens, blues, and browns.
prompt: surreal dark painting of a large floating cluster made of hundreds of glowing multicolored translucent circles and fragments, intertwined with thin golden wires and mechanical details, warm golden light emanating from within the mass, set against a dramatic stormy sky with swirling clouds in deep emerald, indigo and burnt umber tones, painterly oil texture, atmospheric and mysterious
